$description: Screen family ('The pass'): type and component values specific to the screen themes (light, dark). Font names override the editorial ones under data-family="screen", so var(--mep-font-family-serif) follows the family.

serif.$description: Display: headings, kickers, large numbers, quotes.

mono.$description: Every ID (ART-0001, DEC-0001), file paths, token counts, tickets, small uppercase labels.

body.$description: Screen body copy. Editorial web body is 1.5.

letter-spacing.$description: In em, emitted with the unit by the build.

label.$description: Small uppercase labels, set in mono.

offset.$description: Gap between the element and its focus outline.

min.$description: Smallest click or tap target (WCAG 2.5.5). Prefer 48px where space allows.

rotate.$description: In degrees, emitted as deg. The one hero ticket per page only.
